value.rationale: This answers the natural complete covariance-kernel admissibility question for exponential decay in canonical rank distance on all finite-field matrix spaces. Its discrete islands contradict naive metric-negative-type intuition, both high-rank characters give universal failure witnesses, and strictness plus exact nullity at every island is computed. It is structurally uniform in field and two matrix dimensions, not an arbitrary finite enumeration.
